name: season prop line under a week row axis does not correlate on a week it has no column for
description: A SEASON prop is one line for the whole year, so its CTE carries no year or week column -- player_betting_market_with builds it with is_week_scoped = (market_grain === 'game'), which is false for a season market. player_betting_market_join nonetheless called correlate_week_scoped_cte for every player betting column, so this request emitted `t<hash>.year = ...` against a CTE that projects only selection_pid and selection_metric_line, and the whole view died on `42703: column t<hash>.year does not exist`. Not a wrong value -- a hard error that takes the entire view, whatever else is on it. It arrived with fc4a84ca0, which added the week correlation to the SHARED player join to fix the game-prop broadcast without gating it on the column's own grain. Nothing covered it: the only other season-prop fixture (create-a-query-with-fields-from-season-prop-betting-markets) carries no row_axes at all, so the corpus never emitted this shape and the SQL-validity gate was the only thing that could see it. The correct rendering is the season's single line repeated on every week row: that repetition is the DEFECT for a game prop and the FACT for a season prop, which is the distinction the shared join had lost.
expected_query:
with "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[2024]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years), "player_years_weeks" as (SELECT player_years.pid, nfl_year_week_timestamp.year, nfl_year_week_timestamp.week FROM player_years INNER JOIN nfl_year_week_timestamp ON player_years.year = nfl_year_week_timestamp.year WHERE nfl_year_week_timestamp.year = 2024), "t7d903b237a8dc89d9b79d1cbe5f53cf6_markets" as (select "source_id", "source_market_id", "time_type", "prop_markets_index"."esbid" from "prop_markets_index" where "market_type" = 'SEASON_PASSING_YARDS' and "time_type" = 'CLOSE' and "prop_markets_index"."season_year" = 2024 and "source_id" = 'FANDUEL'), "t7d903b237a8dc89d9b79d1cbe5f53cf6" as (select pms.selection_pid, pms.selection_metric_line from "t7d903b237a8dc89d9b79d1cbe5f53cf6_markets" as "m" inner join "prop_market_selections_index" as "pms" on "pms"."source_id" = "m"."source_id" and "pms"."source_market_id" = "m"."source_market_id" and "pms"."time_type" = "m"."time_type" where "pms"."selection_type" in ('OVER')), "player_participation_weeks" as (SELECT pid, year, week, bool_or(is_active) AS is_active
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2024::int AS year, g.week, pgl.is_active
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2024 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2024) src
          GROUP BY pid, year, week), "player_years_teams" as (SELECT pid, year, array_agg(DISTINCT team_code) AS teams
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2024::int AS year, pgl.nfl_team AS team_code
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2024 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2024) src
          GROUP BY pid, year), "team_weeks_played" as (select distinct "team", "year", "week" from ((select "home_nfl_team" as "team", "season_year" as "year", "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2024)) union all (select "away_nfl_team" as "team", "season_year" as "year", "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2024))) as "g") select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, "t7d903b237a8dc89d9b79d1cbe5f53cf6"."selection_metric_line" AS "season_prop_line_betting_market_0", "player_years_weeks"."year", "player_years_weeks"."week", CASE
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.is_active THEN 'active'
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.pid IS NULL
          AND player_years_teams.teams IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM team_weeks_played
            WHERE team_weeks_played.year = player_years_weeks.year
              AND team_weeks_played.week = player_years_weeks.week
              AND team_weeks_played.team = ANY(player_years_teams.teams)
          )
       THEN 'bye'
     ELSE NULL
   END AS participation_status, "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years_weeks" on "player_years_weeks"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join "t7d903b237a8dc89d9b79d1cbe5f53cf6" on "t7d903b237a8dc89d9b79d1cbe5f53cf6"."selection_pid" = "player"."pid" left join "player_participation_weeks" on "player_participation_weeks"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_participation_weeks"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" and "player_participation_weeks"."week" = "player_years_weeks"."week" left join "player_years_teams" on "player_years_teams"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_years_teams"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "t7d903b237a8dc89d9b79d1cbe5f53cf6"."selection_metric_line", "player_years_weeks"."year", "player_years_weeks"."week", CASE
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.is_active THEN 'active'
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.pid IS NULL
          AND player_years_teams.teams IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM team_weeks_played
            WHERE team_weeks_played.year = player_years_weeks.year
              AND team_weeks_played.week = player_years_weeks.week
              AND team_weeks_played.team = ANY(player_years_teams.teams)
          )
       THEN 'bye'
     ELSE NULL
   END, "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by player.first_name || ' ' || player.last_name ASC NULLS LAST, "player"."pid" asc limit 10
